public_publication.live_data: Withheld; no private records or raw API evidence are published.
public_publication.authority: Metric registries, API field/filter definitions, disclosed formulas and warehouse mappings remain intact. Historical verification prose below records design decisions, not a public verification claim. Current public dashboards show no live values.
public_publication.credentials: No API keys or credentials changed or included. Deployment IDs are placeholders; configure an existing AWS profile and deployment variables privately.
public_publication.history: Previously tracked raw data is replaced at this revision; older Git history was not rewritten.

operations_navigation: Call Center Operations is entered only through its main home card, not a top-level audit tab. The card opens Inbound Dashboard; the six existing dashboard/dictionary choices remain inside Operations. Metric definitions and acquisition scopes are unchanged.

current_agent_contract.authority: Sole current agent dashboard and dictionary source. Replaces old illustrative agent tables, hardcoded identities, targets and fake evaluation coverage. Legacy agent entries below are archival, not active mappings.
current_agent_contract.scopes: VOICE with 96 explicitly enumerated STANDARD queue IDs and all initiation methods; activity/occupancy uses 67 routing-profile IDs and all channels, without queue/channel filter. Exact IDs are saved in snapshot request evidence.
current_agent_contract.filters: Full native TOTAL or one native DAY; optional AGENT dimension. Never average native averages or rates. Daily charts retain all four loaded days for selected agent. Team top-eight comparison ignores individual agent selector and says so. Current-state roster ignores historical filters.
current_agent_contract.conversions: Occupancy presentation = raw V2 ratio * 100, classified DERIVED_DISPLAY_CONVERSION, not a new native percentage result. Native activity seconds displayed as hours / 3600 are presentation conversions. Raw values and native units remain unchanged. Unit gates validate occupancy against same-scope native contact/(contact+idle) for each available agent/interval.
current_agent_contract.identity: ListUsers + DescribeUser IdentityInfo FirstName/LastName; fallback Username then User.Id. Join instance_id + normalized Dimensions.AGENT user ID. Current directory names are not historical identity snapshots.
current_agent_contract.current: GetCurrentUserData with explicit queue IDs; native StatusName, StatusStartTimestamp and VOICE available/active slots only. Request and retrieval timestamp retained; customer Contacts array excluded. Not live, not historical availability, missing keys not zero.
current_agent_contract.assistant: Five team comparisons matched (handling and wrap rounded). CONTACTS_HANDLED 5262 vs Assistant 5264 and occupancy 15.278% vs 15.773% remain visibly discrepant; Assistant uses different scope/interface. No per-agent or current-state values independently Assistant-verified.
current_agent_contract.missing: Schedule adherence returned no rows. No zero substituted. Quality score is shown with mixed-form/coverage limitation, not a ranking. Native errors, empty responses and zero remain distinct.
current_agent_contract.warehouse: See docs/agent-operations-snowflake.sql and current registry: immutable raw evidence; fct_connect_metric_interval keyed by instance+metric_spec_hash+scope_hash+interval+dimensions; dim_connect_user join; fct_connect_user_snapshot separate. Semantic projections retain native TOTAL/DAY/AGENT, never roll up averages. Snowflake is a mapping contract, not a deployed or equality-verified database.

retired_centerwide_views.status: Removed from page and navigation at user request. Their legacy contract records are archival only; current operations navigation has inbound, outbound and agent dashboard/dictionary pairs.

current_outbound_contract.authority: This registry is the sole current outbound dashboard/dictionary source. Superseded outbound tables and the historical disclosure are removed from the page. Current verification limitations remain visible; raw evidence is retained.
current_outbound_contract.dictionary_presentation: Uses the inbound dictionary components: topic navigation, search, expandable metric rows, exact request/response and Snowflake disclosures, contract/evidence downloads, and dashboard return. Source links clear topic/search filters and expand the matching definition. A load failure must not fall back to old metrics.
current_outbound_contract.derived_publication: Created-minus-handled is a provisional reporting remainder, excluded from the core performance cards; not a certified customer-not-answered outcome or native metric.
current_outbound_contract.assistant_matching: Five independently queried full-window totals match. The four handled DAY values independently match too: 898, 859, 851, 39 for August 12–15. Badge requires evidence status and value equality. Other daily series, HOUR and QUEUE breakdowns are API-backed only; exact Assistant queue IDs are unavailable.
current_outbound_contract.dashboard: Nine charts across eight mapped families: daily volume; handled reporting-timestamp comparison; date/hour handled heatmap; disconnect breakdown; hold/transfer daily counts; interaction/wrap daily averages; connecting daily seconds; top-six handled queue totals; separately scoped campaign comparison.
current_outbound_contract.filter_behavior: Only completed Aug 12–15 loaded dates are selectable. Disjoint native DAY counts can sum for subranges; no average-of-averages. Queue ranking requires full window. Campaign Aug 27–28 scope is fixed and separately labeled.
current_outbound_contract.warehouse: fct_connect_metric_interval; full instance + metric/filter/scope/interval/dimension key. Preserve raw request/response hashes, null/error/zero distinctions and late-update audit history. Registry includes per-metric semantic names, units, exact filter contracts and shared joins/tests. Do not infer contact-level classifications from aggregate arithmetic.

current_inbound_contract.authority: The referenced registry supersedes legacy inbound mappings below for the current Inbound Dashboard and Inbound Data Dictionary. Other domain mappings remain unchanged.

daily_demand_answers.display: independent lines; not a same-caller funnel

daily_abandonment_origins.display: stack only when both components are available
daily_abandonment_origins.formula: non_primary_abandoned = abandoned_total - primary_abandoned; same native DAY interval and scope

daily_service_rates.display: native rates on one percent scale; not complementary, not summed or averaged

top_queue_abandons.display: six largest returned native values; excludes nulls; click re-queries queue; not exhaustive

comparison_charts.contract_inheritance: Each metric inherits its exact Amazon field, filters, grain, timestamp attribution and warehouse key from the current registry. No new acquisition or semantic metrics.
comparison_charts.warehouse: Read MART_CALL_CENTER.VW_INBOUND_OPERATIONS by the full selected scope key; DAY for daily graphs, queue-scoped TOTAL for ranking. Join daily subtraction inputs on all scope and interval keys.
comparison_charts.missing_policy: Missing daily points remain gaps. Duplicate native metric/day entries are ambiguous and hidden, never summed. Failed/negative subtraction hides the whole stack for that day.

current_inbound_contract.primary_not_answered_publication: Provisional reporting remainder; interpretation disputed by Assistant. Do not use as a verified unique-caller count or initiation-date cohort.
current_inbound_contract.filter_behavior: Live read-only refresh on Apply, complete days only, maximum 31 days within 89 days. A failed refresh retains the previous explicitly dated snapshot.
current_inbound_contract.format: Native API results stored at full precision, counts formatted as integers, percentages to one decimal, durations rounded to seconds. Native averages/rates are not added or averaged across intervals.

governance_rule: Every call-center metric change must compare the director question, Connect Assistant interpretation and value, reproducible Amazon API result, Snowflake semantic result, and dashboard display for an identical request envelope; update the playbook when the process or learned rules change.

dictionary_concept.purpose: Pair each action-oriented dashboard with a verified data dictionary that shows exactly how every value is sourced or derived and records verification against Amazon Connect Assistant and a reproducible Amazon API request.

call_center_metrics.purpose: A centerwide director page containing only high-impact metrics whose exact definitions live in the paired Call Center Metrics Dictionary.
call_center_metrics.assistant_comparison_rule: Publish Assistant verified only when the label, value, window, timezone, queue scope, channel, initiation-method scope, threshold, and metric grain match the reproducible API envelope.

amazon.historical_request_grain: TOTAL over 2026-08-01/2026-08-27 ET. Month points use one TOTAL request per ET month; hour-of-week uses HOUR.
TOTAL over 2026-08-01/2026-08-27 ET. The three initiation methods are applied inside the metric filter, not after aggregation.
TOTAL over 2026-08-01/2026-08-27 ET on the same initiation-method filter as the created parent.
TOTAL over 2026-08-01/2026-08-27 ET. A rate is NOT additive across intervals; store the native value with its window and carry numerator/denominator to re-derive.
TOTAL over 2026-08-01/2026-08-27 ET. The LT 30 threshold is part of the request key; a different threshold is a different column, not a re-aggregation.

amazon.historical_request_grain: TOTAL over 2026-08-01/2026-08-16 ET. A DIFFERENT window from the inbound cards; never added to Aug 1-26 values.

metrics.formula: CAMPAIGN_CONTACTS_CONNECTED / CAMPAIGN_SEND_ATTEMPTS * 100 = 7 / 44 * 100 = 15.9%. RECIPIENTS_TARGETED is not the denominator.

metrics.meaning: Month-by-month view of the same queued abandoned population. Jun-Aug 2026 are API totals; Sep 2025-May 2026 are provisional archive placeholders.

amazon.historical_request_grain: One TOTAL request per ET month; GetMetricDataV2 recent-history limit prevents a full 12-month pull

metrics.formula: For each verified month, sum CONTACTS_ABANDONED returned for all standard queues by one TOTAL request covering that ET calendar month. Older points require the durable archive.

snowflake.aggregation: SUM queue values for each requested ET month

metrics.meaning: The same queued abandoned population across all 24 ET hours and all seven weekdays, at 1 week, 2 week, and 1 month windows.

amazon.historical_request_grain: HOUR requested in two-day chunks because hourly requests must span less than three days

metrics.formula: Sum Amazon-provided CONTACTS_ABANDONED HOUR results across queues into weekday(local_interval_start) x hour(local_interval_start). No profile weights or proportional allocation.

snowflake.grain: queue x local day x hour
snowflake.aggregation: GROUP BY DIM_DATE.DAY_OF_WEEK, HOUR_OF_DAY in America/New_York

dashboard_surface.source_link_contract: Every KPI card, the director-priority strip, both shape visuals, and every action-guidance row exposes a button[data-cc-jump-view="call-center-metrics-dictionary"][data-cc-jump-target="ccm-def-*"]. Activating it must switch the view, scroll the row into view, move focus to the row, and flash it. Verified by scripts/verify-ccm-source-links.mjs.
dashboard_surface.action_guidance_contract: Every governed centerwide signal carries a state, the exception it represents, an owner, and the next decision. Action text must not restate the metric definition; the definition is reached through the row link.
dashboard_surface.shape_verification_rule: Every visual distinguishes exact API points from provisional archive points. The heat map is API verified from HOUR results; only Sep 2025-May 2026 trend values remain provisional.

historical_request_grain.published_totals: Interval.IntervalPeriod=TOTAL over the stated window, TimeZone=America/New_York, end time exclusive, complete ET calendar days only.
historical_request_grain.trend_required: One Interval.IntervalPeriod=TOTAL request per ET calendar month. Jun-Aug 2026 acquired; older nine months require the durable Snowflake/data-lake archive because GetMetricDataV2 rejects the older range.
historical_request_grain.heatmap_required: Interval.IntervalPeriod=HOUR in two-day chunks, TimeZone=America/New_York, collapsed to weekday x hour. Acquired and reconciled for 1 week, 2 weeks, and 1 month.
historical_request_grain.warehouse_key: Request-envelope hash + metric + filter set + threshold + interval grain. Connect valid interval enums are FIFTEEN_MIN, THIRTY_MIN, HOUR, DAY, WEEK, TOTAL.

dashboard_contract.ui_filter_rule: A date selection remains pending until a successful API refresh replaces the governed snapshot; never relabel frozen values with an unqueried window.

connect_assistant_metric_dictionary.purpose: Govern the common questions a call center director asks Connect Assistant and reproduce each answer through Amazon Connect APIs and Snowflake without changing population, event time, or grain.

amazon_defaults.historical_attribution: contact completion/disconnect unless the selected metric is explicitly event-driven
amazon_defaults.metric_filter_value_semantics: Multiple values in one MetricFilterValues array are OR-evaluated. An INITIATION_METHOD metric filter can coexist with explicit QUEUE resource IDs and CHANNEL=VOICE.

assistant_verification.role: Terminology and console-label cross-check only; official API documentation plus a reproducible API request govern conflicts.

live_api_correction.invalid_claim: CONTACTS_HANDLED_INCOMING is a standalone GetMetricDataV2 metric name.
live_api_correction.governed_contract: Use CONTACTS_HANDLED with INITIATION_METHOD values INBOUND, TRANSFER, and QUEUE_TRANSFER. The phrase Contacts handled incoming is a display label, not the V2 metric name.

live_api_validation.historical_metric_batch: Accepted by GetMetricDataV2 with explicit standard queue ID and CHANNEL=VOICE: CONTACTS_CREATED, CONTACTS_QUEUED, CONTACTS_HANDLED, CONTACTS_ABANDONED, ABANDONMENT_RATE, AVG_ABANDON_TIME, AVG_QUEUE_ANSWER_TIME, MAX_QUEUED_TIME, AVG_HANDLE_TIME, AVG_INTERACTION_TIME, AVG_HOLD_TIME, AVG_AFTER_CONTACT_WORK_TIME, CONTACTS_PUT_ON_HOLD, CONTACTS_HOLD_ABANDONS, CONTACTS_TRANSFERRED_OUT, AGENT_ANSWER_RATE, AGENT_NON_RESPONSE, CONTACTS_TRANSFERRED_OUT_INTERNAL, CONTACTS_TRANSFERRED_OUT_EXTERNAL.
live_api_validation.threshold_metric_batch: Accepted by GetMetricDataV2 with Threshold=[{Comparison:LT,ThresholdValue:x}]: SUM_CONTACTS_ABANDONED_IN_X, SERVICE_LEVEL, SUM_CONTACTS_ANSWERED_IN_X. The V2 Threshold shape contains Comparison and ThresholdValue; it has no unit field.
live_api_validation.current_metric_batch: Accepted by GetCurrentMetricData: CONTACTS_IN_QUEUE with Unit=COUNT and OLDEST_CONTACT_AGE with Unit=SECONDS.

snowflake_defaults.metric_primary_key: instance_id + start_time_utc + end_time_utc + queue_scope_hash + channel + metric_name + metric_filters_hash + threshold_hash
snowflake_defaults.refresh: MERGE by immutable key; retain retrieval timestamp, payload hash, batch ID, and raw response; reprocess the approved late-arrival window

office_hours.api_pattern: Issue one UTC-converted request per local ET date or use native hourly buckets; sum count metrics only.
office_hours.non_additive_rule: Never simple-average rate, percentage, maximum, or average metrics across daily or hourly buckets. Preserve native numerator/denominator where available or calculate from contact records.

inbound_native_only_display.policy: Display Amazon-native metrics and filters wherever available. The explicitly approved original-inbound answer bridge may display calculated remainders, but they must be labeled calculated and must not be relabeled as abandonment.

native_partitions.parent: CONTACTS_ABANDONED across all displayed initiation methods

original_inbound_answer_reconciliation.warning: Neither remainder is a native Amazon metric. Other not answered requires contact-record terminal-path classification; do not relabel it as abandonment.

display_flow_connections.rule: Connect only when reporting window, instance, channel, queue scope, filters, and contact-leg grain are identical.
Each destination carries the same 10,067 original-inbound answered contact legs into a different native diagnostic view.
Carry forward only when both native inputs use an identical request envelope; this is an approved arithmetic control, not a native metric.

Carry the same native 612 parent into Table 1D and Table 2. Table 1D bands must be derived from QueueInfo.Duration at contact-record grain because SUM_CONTACTS_ABANDONED_IN_X does not support INITIATION_METHOD; withhold band values until their sum equals 612.
The same all-standard-queue abandoned population is carried into the exclusive wait-band partition.
The same 372 non-original-inbound abandoned queue legs are carried into their native initiation-method detail: 82 transfer + 288 API + 2 callback + 0 queue transfer.
The same held-contact population is carried into the mutually exclusive hold-outcome control.
The same hold-disconnect population is carried into the disconnect-reason partition.

joins: FCT_CONTACT_LEG to FCT_AGENT_OFFER_ATTEMPT on INSTANCE_ID, CONTACT_ID

DISCONNECT_REASON = 'AGENT_DISCONNECT' AND CONNECTED_TO_AGENT_TIMESTAMP IS NOT NULL

CAMPAIGN_ID IS NOT NULL AND DELIVERY_MODE='AGENT_ASSISTED_VOICE' AND ANSWERING_MACHINE_DETECTION_STATUS = 'HUMAN_ANSWERED'
